components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The bordered violet action used for the next deliberate step in a reading.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:10px 16px; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--accent); font:500 13px/1.55 var(--font-mono); transition:border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--text); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:var(--focus); } .ds-button-primary:active { background:rgba(181,138,239,0.22); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A neutral outlined action for secondary reading controls.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { display:inline-flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:10px 16px; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--text); font:500 13px/1.55 var(--font-mono); transition:border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-quiet:hover { border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline:1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:var(--focus); } .ds-button-quiet:active { background:rgba(181,138,239,0.22); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A compact destructive control reserved for deleting a local journal entry.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { display:inline-flex; min-height:34px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:6px 10px; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid rgba(239,154,154,0.45); border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:var(--danger); font:500 13px/1.55 var(--font-mono); transition:border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-danger:hover { border-color:var(--danger); background:rgba(239,154,154,0.08); } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline:1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:var(--focus); } .ds-button-danger:active { background:rgba(239,154,154,0.14); }

components.name: Markdown Note Editor
components.description: A local reflection editor with Write, Split, and Preview modes sharing one Markdown renderer.
components.css: .ds-markdown-editor { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:6px; } .ds-markdown-editor header { display:flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:6px 8px 6px 13px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--field-background); } .ds-markdown-editor > div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); min-height:260px; } .ds-markdown-editor textarea, .ds-markdown-editor article { min-width:0; padding:16px; background:transparent; color:var(--text); } .ds-markdown-editor textarea { border:0; border-right:1px solid var(--line); resize:vertical; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: A compact text navigation on one hairline with a violet current-state underline.
components.html: Tarot ArcanaTodayReadingsNotes
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; min-height:70px; align-items:stretch; justify-content:space-between; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); font-family:var(--font-mono); } .ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; position:relative; align-items:center; color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.12em; } .ds-nav-brand { color:var(--text) !important; font-size:16px; font-weight:500; } .ds-nav-links { display:flex; align-items:stretch; gap:48px; } .ds-nav-link { font-size:12px; transition:color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.ds-is-current { color:var(--text); } .ds-nav-link.ds-is-current::after { position:absolute; right:0; bottom:-1px; left:0; height:2px; background:var(--accent); content:""; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-brand:focus-visible { outline:1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:var(--focus); } .ds-nav-link:active { color:var(--accent); }

components.name: Reading Choice
components.description: One cell in the dedicated Readings route, combining count, spread geometry, label, description, and direction.
components.html: 03Past, present, futureSee the movement around a question
components.css: .ds-reading-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:32px 58px minmax(0,1fr) 24px; min-height:78px; align-items:center; gap:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; font-family:var(--font-mono); transition:color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-reading-row:hover { color:var(--text); } .ds-reading-row:focus-visible { outline:1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:var(--focus); } .ds-reading-row:active { background:var(--accent-soft); } .ds-reading-count { color:var(--accent); font-size:12px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-spread-glyph { width:56px; height:36px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1; } .ds-reading-copy { display:grid; gap:2px; min-width:0; } .ds-reading-copy strong { color:var(--text); font-size:13px; font-weight:500; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-reading-copy small { font-size:11px; } .ds-row-arrow { width:20px; height:20px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-linecap:square; stroke-width:1.4; }

components.name: Tarot Card Back
components.description: The authored violet-line card back used before a reading is revealed.
components.css: .ds-card-back { position:relative; display:block; width:180px; aspect-ratio:300/520; overflow:hidden; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:6px; background:#242938; color:var(--accent); transition:background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-card-back::before { position:absolute; inset:13px; border:1px solid currentColor; content:""; } .ds-card-back:hover { background:#2c3141; } .ds-card-back:focus-visible { outline:1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:var(--focus); } .ds-card-back:active { background:#32384b; } .ds-card-back-mark { position:absolute; top:50%; left:50%; width:72px; height:72px; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-card-back-mark::before, .ds-card-back-mark::after, .ds-card-back-mark span, .ds-card-back-mark i { position:absolute; background:currentColor; content:""; } .ds-card-back-mark::before { top:0; bottom:0; left:50%; width:1px; } .ds-card-back-mark::after { top:50%; right:0; left:0; height:1px; } .ds-card-back-mark span { inset:20%; border:1px solid currentColor; background:transparent; } .ds-card-back-mark i { top:46%; left:46%; width:8%; height:8%; }

components.name: Journal List Item
components.description: A full-width saved-reading selector that stays on the shared page ground.
components.css: .ds-journal-item { display:grid; width:260px; gap:7px; padding:22px 24px 22px 0; cursor:pointer; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:transparent; color:var(--muted); text-align:left; font-family:var(--font-mono); transition:background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-journal-item:hover, .ds-journal-item.ds-is-selected { background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--text); } .ds-journal-item.ds-is-selected { box-shadow:inset -2px 0 0 var(--accent); } .ds-journal-item:focus-visible { outline:1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; box-shadow:var(--focus); } .ds-journal-item:active { background:rgba(181,138,239,0.22); } .ds-journal-date { color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; letter-spacing:0.04em; } .ds-journal-item strong { color:var(--text); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; } .ds-journal-item > span:not(.ds-journal-date) { font-size:12px; } .ds-journal-item small { color:var(--accent); font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; }

narrative.northStar: The Reader's Notebook, Dawn to Midnight
narrative.overview:
Tarot Arcana is a quiet working instrument with two composed settings: midnight ink for low ambient light and dawn paper for brighter reading. Warm monospaced notation and a small set of ruled controls recede behind the reading in both. Its atmosphere comes from restraint and continuity rather than occult decoration. Rider-Waite-Smith card art supplies the only dense texture and broad color spectrum.

The interface is compact, deliberate, and planar. Hairline divisions organize related tasks; muted copy stays subordinate; violet appears when the system needs attention, focus, or selection. Theme changes remap semantic roles rather than mechanically inverting the interface, and the visitor's choice is kept locally.
keyCharacteristics: Composed midnight-ink and dawn-paper palettes built from the same semantic roles.
One monospaced family across display, reading, label, and control roles.
Hairline rules and open fields in place of decorative containers.
Muted violet reserved for interaction, selection, and focus.
Natural tarot imagery left visually dominant and uncropped.
Compact corners, brief transitions, and one deliberate card-turn motion.

rules.name: The Violet Signal Rule
rules.body: Violet marks action, focus, selection, or reading state; it is not a general decorative fill.

rules.name: The Card Art Carries Color Rule
rules.body: Keep the interface low-chroma so Rider-Waite-Smith imagery remains the only richly colored and textured material.

rules.name: The Dawn / Midnight Rule
rules.body: Theme changes remap semantic roles. Never invert card art, weaken violet's interaction meaning, or turn light mode into pure white and black.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use IBM Plex Mono throughout; create hierarchy with the established scale and casing before introducing any new typographic voice.

rules.name: The Useful Line Rule
rules.body: Keep explanatory and interpretive prose within 62–70ch so it reads as a concise note, not an essay wall.

rules.name: The Rule Becomes Stack Rule
rules.body: A desktop divider denotes a relationship, not a permanent column; below 760px it rotates into a horizontal boundary and preserves content order. The Celtic Cross is the exception: its geometry remains intact inside horizontal scroll.

rules.name: The Deliberate Depth Rule
rules.body: Daily and spread views begin with the card and its divinatory meaning. Notes, full Waite text, and correspondence systems appear only after an explicit action.

rules.name: The Open Desk Rule
rules.body: Prefer one shared ground with spacing and hairlines over nested cards or boxed dashboard modules.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain planar; depth belongs to physical card art and explicit interaction states, never to decorative containers.

rules.name: The Six-Pixel Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Functional controls and full-size tarot frames do not exceed a 6px radius; avoid pills and soft floating panels.

dos: Do let tarot artwork provide the broad color and texture while both interface palettes remain low-chroma.
Do use hairlines, open space, and shared ground to group tasks before adding a container.
Do reserve violet for action, current state, focus, and selection.
Do keep reflection Markdown locally framed and render it consistently in editor previews and the journal.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the shipped reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce ornate fantasy framing, star fields, gradients, glassmorphism, or gold-on-purple occult styling.
Don't turn navigation, reading rows, or journal regions into elevated dashboard cards.
Don't add a second display typeface; the single monospaced voice is the identity.
Don't crop or color-treat Rider-Waite-Smith art as decoration; present the full card as source material.
Don't use pills, oversized radii, glyph-only navigation, or ornamental icons.
